title: No specializations within etale fibres over a point with finite U-fibres

standard_prerequisites.name: Generalizations lift along etale morphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Builds the tower of specializations through t and s.

standard_prerequisites.name: Points of the presentation
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Properties of Spaces, lemma points-presentation (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the initial point r with t(r) = u, s(r) = u'.

standard_prerequisites.name: Finiteness characterization
standard_prerequisites.use: The second part gives finiteness of the fibre of |U| -> |X| over x.

core_obligations: Reduce U affine; pick r with t(r) = u and s(r) = u'.
Iterate: lift generalizations along t to get r' -> r with t(r') = u', set u'' = s(r'), and continue; the displayed diagram records the tower.
If u^(n+1) = u^(n) for some n, the collapse argument forces u = u'.
Otherwise all specializations are strict and {u, u', u'', ...} is an infinite set of points of U over x, contradicting finiteness of the fibre.
proof_roadmap: Tower iteration with the displayed diagram; collapse dichotomy; infiniteness contradiction.
difficulty_reason: The tower-collapse dichotomy is the substance; the contradiction is a direct application of the carded finiteness lemma.
